{{Quote|The communications backbone of the Republic has become a favored target of the Separatists. Some attacks have been outright destructive, but the insidious attempts to taint our channels with disinformation and viral data is just as dangerous.|Senate Bureau of Intelligence Director Armand Isard|<ref name="HoloNet 14:2:12">{{InsiderCite|65|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:2:12}}</ref>}}
The '''shadowfeed''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]-sponsored unauthorized [[holofeed]]s and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program broadcast throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Most shadowfeeds originated from the communications arrays in [[Murkhana City/Legends|Murkhana City]].

It was the CIS version of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. It was used to spread propaganda to worlds affiliated with the CIS.

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|For a Republic that had enjoyed total control over the media through government seizure of the HoloNet, the emergence of a Confederacy pirate 'shadowfeed' broadcast became a vexing problem. Now the public had dueling propaganda to choose from.|[[Voren Na'al]], ''[[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|The New Essential Chronology]]''|<ref name="nec" />}}
[[File:Dooku_TCW.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Count Dooku and the greater CIS government used the Shadowfeed to push the Separatist narrative (Dooku and a Separatist logo, pictured).]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ease of communications was of vital importance to both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] was the most advanced and widely-used communications grid in existence at the time, and was used by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] media. As such, it was seen as a key propaganda tool by both factions; however, the Republic exerted total control over the media after a government seizure of the HoloNet, and stopped the Separatists from using it themselves. For several months after the start of the conflict in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic used it to censor information and broadcast anti-Separatist propaganda.<ref name="nec" />

Approximately nine months after Geonosis,<ref name="nec" /> the Separatists were able to gain access to the HoloNet via hyperwave transceivers<ref name="loe">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> and nodes spread through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Shadowfeed 15:01:15">{{InsiderCite|73|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:01:15 Edition}}</ref> with the help of expert slicers.<ref name="HoloNet 14:2:12" /> Suddenly, the CIS and its leader, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], could broadcast its own propaganda, and the public had two sets of "facts" to deal with.<ref name="nec" /> Broadcast primarily from [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], this new "shadowfeed" was aimed at both Republic and Confederate citizens;<ref name="dl" /> it reported only Separatist victories and Republic misdeeds and atrocities.<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:2:14">{{InsiderCite|65|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition}}</ref> The CIS Shadowfeed helped shatter the Republic invincibility alluded to in the Republic's own propaganda, driving the masses of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] into the fear of an impending Separatist victory, while the Republic desperately attempted to assure them they were safe.<ref name="rotsn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

===Communications struggle===
Propaganda therefore played a key role in the war.<ref name="rotsn" /> Count Dooku was a highly adept speaker, whose simple, powerful appeals to people's spiritual wants and desires for freedom earned him the nickname "Gentle Hand."<ref name="EGTWAC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref><ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] known only as "[[Ryloth Resa]]" lured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to her broadcasts with better musical selections than those of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]], and made emotional appeals for them to desert and spread stories of Republic mistreatment of clones. The [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] geneticist [[Ull Haber]] targeted the Republic's citizens, claiming that the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] had suppressed the genes that would allow clone troopers to integrate with mainstream society, and that the Republic had covered up numerous incidents in which clones were maddened by bloodlust and massacred Republic civilians. Haber also claimed that the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] had promised the clones settlement on selected Republic "liberty worlds" after the war, which would be ruled as the clones saw fit.<ref name="EGTWAC" />

The CIS Shadowfeed presented a vexing problem to the Republic. Attempts were made to shut it down, to no avail.<ref name="nec" /> In addition to its propagandizing, the CIS also frequently sabotaged Republic communications, with both munitions and experimental jamming technology. In response, [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] formed a [[Cryptanalysis Department]], headed by [[Ilko Deminar]], tasked with preventing such attacks and shutting down the CIS Shadowfeed.<ref name="HoloNet 14:2:12" />

===Aargau and Dooku's address of 22 BBY===
{{Quote|By reading the spurious reports from Coruscant regarding our withdrawal from such temporary worlds as Raxus Prime and Ord Janon, the Republic would have its citizenry believe we are on the run. Given the graft rampant in the Senate, it comes as no surprise that their biased media agencies are just as corrupt. The forces on our borders and outlying colonial assets are admittedly facing greater numbers, but with our inexhaustible supply of troops and materiel from the Neimoidian coffer-worlds, Techno Union home foundries and mighty guild-worlds, it's only a matter of time before the Republic is overwhelmed.|Dooku's shadowfeed address to the Confederacy|<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:2:14" />}}
[[File:HailfireDroid-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|300px|The Republic suspected that the CIS was constructing Hailfire droids (pictured) on Aargau, to which the CIS Shadowfeed blasted the Republic for planting military forces on a neutral world.]]
In an early CIS Shadowfeed dispatch (dated [[22 BBY/Legends|14:2:14 GrS]]), Separatist propagandists reported on the situation on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]], the headquarters world of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]],<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:2:14" /> a formally neutral commerce guild<ref name="HoBS">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> that, in practice, acted as a Confederate ally. Despite being a tacit supporter of the Confederacy, Aargau was officially neutral in the Clone Wars; thus, the CIS and Banking Clan were greatly angered when the Republic posted military forces to the world. [[Three Statutes of Aargau|Local planetary law]] stipulated that it was illegal for noncitizens on Aargau to possess or use arms, yet the Republic refused to pull out, citing the protection of its citizens and the disappearance of an inspection team posted to Aargau to try and link recovered Separatist [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]] to manufacturing plants within the [[IBC Arcology (Aargau)|IBC Arcology]] on Aargau. The shadowfeed report was biased towards Aargau and the Banking Clan, making no reference to the IBC's Separatist links, but frequently mentioning the planet's neutrality in the war, and the Republic's breaking of local law.<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:2:14" />

The same dispatch included a public address made by Separatist leader Count Dooku in response to Republic reports that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had conquered vital Separatist worlds. Claiming that these had been withdrawals from temporary bases on worlds such as [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and [[Ord Janon]], Dooku blasted the Republic media as trying to disseminate accounts of mass CIS retreats because of Republic pressure. In his speech, Dooku stated that such reports were false, labeling the Republic media and [[Senate]] as corrupt: he went on to boast about the Separatist military charged with protecting their allies' commercial headquarters, and promised the citizens of the Confederacy that before long, the war would be won. Simultaneously, the Republic was telling its own citizenry that the Separatists were on the run and on the brink of defeat, with neither side striving for honesty.<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:2:14" />

===Bassadro===
{{Quote|The callous lack of value shown by the Republic in this exercise is appalling. Each of those miners represented a hard worker with invested skill levels. The synergistic aggregate of the village total was far beyond the worth of each individual.|Official Separatist statement, made by Shu Mai, on the events at Bassadro, via the shadowfeed|<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:3:10">{{InsiderCite|66|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:3:10 Edition}}</ref>}}
[[File:Shu_Sullust.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Shu Mai, speaking of Bassadro]]
The CIS Shadowfeed dealt a serious blow to the Republic in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Bassadro]], nine months after the start of the Clone Wars.<ref name="nec" /> [[Bassadro]] was a world rich in resources, and was captured by the CIS early in the war; in response, the Republic sent a task force led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Empatojayos Brand]] to retake the planet. In a twelve-day battle,<ref name="HoloNet 14:2:12" /> the Republic forced Separatist troops, led by [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Domb Treetor]], to seek shelter in [[Agao Ranges|dormant volcano ranges]]. Rather than engaging the opposition directly, Master Brand opted to fire concussion missiles at overhanging [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]] rock formations, filling the air with millions of glassy shards. Many Separatist assets<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:3:10" /> and troops were destroyed,<ref name="nec" /> and a local mining village, [[Agao-Nir]], was also hit by the shrapnel. Over four hundred unaffiliated, native miners were killed. Brand only ceased the onslaught after the surrender of Major Treetor,<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:3:10" /> who signed a treaty with the Jedi Master handing Bassadro and its mineral wealth back to the Republic.<ref name="HoloNet 14:2:12" />

Losing Bassadro was a blow for the CIS, but the shadowfeed was quickly able to put a spin on the story<ref name="nec" /> and use Brand's callous actions to its advantage. Based on unverified transmissions to the CIS by the captured Treetor, the CIS shadowfeed reported on the miners' deaths, claiming that Treetor surrendered purely to save any more innocent lives, in a dispatch dated [[21 BBY/Legends|14:3:10 GrS]]. [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] also made an official Confederate statement via the shadowfeed, condemning the Republic's actions.<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:3:10" /> Meanwhile, the Republic media either omitted mention of the miners' deaths<ref name="HoloNet 14:2:12" /> or twisted the truth to their benefit, starting the most well known duel between the two factions' propaganda. The Republic intensified its attempts to shut down the troublesome shadowfeed.<ref name="nec" />

In the same dispatch, the Separatists also reported of the newly minted [[CIS credit]], and the work being done by the InterGalactic Banking Clan to bolster its value, which, according to IBC [[Communications officer/Legends|Communications officer]] [[Lo Vapeet]], was at fifty percent of the value of a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credit]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:3:10" /> Meanwhile, on Coruscant, the [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]] was formed as a result of the shadowfeed. The actions of the Confederacy's propagandists had turned some Republic citizens fanatically loyal, and COMPOR's rallies and marches were just one way they rebelled against the CIS and championed the Republic's cause.<ref name="nec" />

===Tambor and Ando===
{{Quote|Not surprisingly, this story has yet to be reported in the government-dominated mainstream Republic media.|14:4:12 GrS CIS Shadowfeed report, referring to Wat Tambor's rescue|<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:4:12">{{InsiderCite|67|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:4:12 Edition}}</ref>}}
[[File:Wat_Tambor_SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|The rescue of General Wat Tambor (pictured) was a boon to the CIS Shadowfeed.]]
Just over one month later on [[Great ReSynchronization|14:4:12 GrS]], the Confederacy distributed another shadowfeed dispatch, detailing the [[Mission to Delrian|rescue]] of [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], as well as a breach of local law by the Republic on the planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]&mdash;two events not publicized in the Republic media. Tambor's rescue was used as a morale booster to the worlds of the Confederacy, highlighting the inefficiencies of the Republic and the bravery and cunning of the Separatists. Tambor&mdash;who served as leader of the Separatist-allied,<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:4:12" /> if officially neutral,<ref name="HoBS" /> Techno Union, the [[Combat engineer (Techno Union)/Legends|Supervising Combat Engineer]] of the CIS,<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:4:12" /> and a Separatist general<ref name="ForcesofDark">''[[The Clone Wars: Forces of Darkness]]''</ref>&mdash;had been incarcerated by the Republic on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]],<ref name="nec" /> an industrial world with ties to Tambor<ref name="TEGtW-AC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> that changed hands several times during the war. Overall, however, Metalron would stand as one of the greatest CIS foundry worlds as part of the [[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Cradle of the Confederacy]] region.<ref name="TEGtW-AC" />

At the order of Chancellor Palpatine, Tambor was transported to a detainment center on the remote<ref name="nec" /> prison planet<ref name="Evazan">{{DB|character|doctorevazan|Evazan, Doctor}}</ref> [[Delrian/Legends|Delrian]]<ref name="nec" /> in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> In truth, however, Palpatine's transfer of Tambor was part of his plan to have the Techno Union foreman rescued in order to prolong the war, as per his designs as the Sith Lord puppet master Darth Sidious.<ref name="nec" /> The center's favored security firm was owned by the Commerce Guild, which allowed the Confederacy access to detailed specifics of the facility's layout and security. Tambor, kept under constant guard by eight [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], was permitted a visit by two Skakoan legal deputies,<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:4:12" /> accompanied by [[Nuri]], a shapeshifting [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="nec" /> The two Skakoans then decompressed their pressure cells, causing an explosion that took the lives of the clone troopers&mdash;as well as [[Death/Legends|their own]]. Nuri then used classified Techno Union technology to bypass the facility's defenses and flee with Tambor. The shadowfeed report lauded the Skakoans' heroics and the Techno Union's technology, and noted the story's absence in Republic media.<ref name="Shadowfeed 14:4:12" />

===Murkhana and conclusion===
After the Confederacy of Independent Systems were forced onto the defensive with the start of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Republic forces began to close in on the Shadowfeed's origin world of [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]]. Separatist propaganda largely went silent after the Republic took the planet in the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]], but some propagandists, like "Ryloth Resa," remained unaccounted for and their true identities were never discovered.<ref name="EGTWAC" />
